title: Vaccination Schedule and Biosecurity
content: Biosecurity begins at the entrance with disinfection mats and designated footwear. Unauthorized visitors are strictly barred from the barn. Vaccinations must adhere strictly to schedule (Newcastle Disease, Gumboro/IBD, Infectious Bronchitis). When administering live vaccines through drinking water, use solely dechlorinated water with a stabilizer such as skimmed milk powder.

quiz.question: Which water source must NEVER be used for live vaccine administration?
options: Water mixed with skimmed milk powder
quiz.explanation: Chlorine instantaneously kills live vaccine virus particles, rendering the entire vaccination ineffective.
